title: Produce global and local image views
prompt: Generate independent square crops for each BCHW image/view, resize bilinearly, and return view batches and (top,left,side) metadata. Sizes/scales are equal-length positive sequences; the first two views are global. Scales specify crop side as a fraction of min(H,W). This core omits photometric augmentation.
